scope: Component exploration with checkpoint weights and calibration activations; no HTTP or image-quality qualification.
limitations: Streaming quantization includes per-call weight conversion; only the largest tested rows show potential gains.
Weight-only group128 implementation has large numerical error; root cause remains undetermined.
Finer activation groups reduce error but eliminate speed benefits.
Low-rank correction trained on independent request0 does not reliably generalize to independent request1.
